name: Phone Charger
description: Guidelines for traveling with phone charger in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Standard wall plugs, charging blocks, and USB cables are fully allowed in carry-on baggage. (Note: Only portable power banks/battery packs are restricted).

checkedBag.reason: Phone chargers and cables are allowed in checked baggage.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring phone charger on a plane?

travelTips: Standard wall plugs, charging blocks, and USB cables are fully allowed in carry-on baggage. (Note: Only portable power banks/battery packs are restricted).

faq.question: Is phone charger allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Phone Charger is allowed in carry-on luggage. Standard wall plugs, charging blocks, and USB cables are fully allowed in carry-on baggage. (Note: Only portable power banks/battery packs are restricted).

faq.question: Can you pack phone charger in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Phone Charger is allowed in checked bags. Phone chargers and cables are allowed in checked baggage.
